paragraphs.en: American farmers have been complaining of labor shortages for several years. The complaints are unlikely to stop without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers.
paragraphs.zh: 美国农民多年来一直抱怨劳动力短缺。如果不对农业工人的移民规定进行全面改革，这些抱怨不太可能停止。

sentences.en: American farmers have been complaining of labor shortages for several years.
The complaints are unlikely to stop without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers.

paragraphs.en: Congress has obstructed efforts to create a more straightforward visa for agricultural workers that would let foreign workers stay longer in the U.S. and change jobs within the industry. If this doesn't change, American businesses, communities, and consumers will be the losers.
paragraphs.zh: 国会一直阻挠为农业工人创建更简便签证的努力，这种签证将允许外国工人在美国停留更长时间并在该行业内更换工作。如果这种情况不改变，美国企业、社区和消费者将成为输家。

sentences.en: Congress has obstructed efforts to create a more straightforward visa for agricultural workers that would let foreign workers stay longer in the U.S. and change jobs within the industry.
If this doesn't change, American businesses, communities, and consumers will be the losers.

paragraphs.en: Perhaps half of U.S. farm laborers are undocumented immigrants. As fewer such workers enter the country, the characteristics of the agricultural workforce are changing. Today's farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico, are more likely to be settled rather than migrating and more likely to be married than single. They're also aging. At the start of this century, about one-third of crop workers were over the age of 35. Now more than half are. And picking crops is hard on older bodies. One oft- debated cure for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it's been all along: Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm.
paragraphs.zh: 美国农场劳动力中大约有一半是无证移民。随着此类工人进入该国的人数减少，农业劳动力的特征正在发生变化。今天的农场劳动者虽然仍以在墨西哥出生为主，但更可能是定居而非迁徙，更可能是已婚而非单身。他们也在老龄化。在本世纪初，约三分之一的农作物工人年龄在35岁以上。现在超过一半。而且采摘农作物对年长的身体来说很艰难。对于这种劳动力短缺，一个经常被辩论的解决方案仍然像一直以来那样不切实际:本土美国工人不会回到农场。

sentences.en: Perhaps half of U.S. farm laborers are undocumented immigrants.
As fewer such workers enter the country, the characteristics of the agricultural workforce are changing.
Today's farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico, are more likely to be settled rather than migrating and more likely to be married than single.
They're also aging.
At the start of this century, about one-third of crop workers were over the age of 35.
Now more than half are.
And picking crops is hard on older bodies.
One oft- debated cure for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it's been all along: Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm.

paragraphs.en: Mechanization isn't the answer, either – not yet, at least. Production of corn, cotton, rice, soybeans, and wheat has been largely mechanized, but many high-value, labor-intensive crops, such as strawberries, need labor. Even dairy farms, where robots do a small share of milking, have a long way to go before they're automated.
paragraphs.zh: 机械化也不是答案——至少目前还不是。玉米、棉花、水稻、大豆和小麦的生产已经基本实现机械化，但许多高价值、劳动密集型作物，如草莓，需要劳动力。即使是奶牛场，机器人只完成一小部分挤奶工作，离自动化还有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: Mechanization isn't the answer, either – not yet, at least.
Production of corn, cotton, rice, soybeans, and wheat has been largely mechanized, but many high-value, labor-intensive crops, such as strawberries, need labor.
Even dairy farms, where robots do a small share of milking, have a long way to go before they're automated.

paragraphs.en: As a result, farms have grown increasingly reliant on temporary guest workers using the H-2A visa to fill the gaps in the workforce. Starting around 2012, requests for the visas rose sharply; from 2011 to 2016 the number of visas issued more than doubled.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，农场越来越依赖使用H-2A签证的临时客工来填补劳动力缺口。大约从2012年开始，签证申请急剧上升；从2011年到2016年，签证发放数量增加了一倍多。

sentences.en: As a result, farms have grown increasingly reliant on temporary guest workers using the H-2A visa to fill the gaps in the workforce.
Starting around 2012, requests for the visas rose sharply; from 2011 to 2016 the number of visas issued more than doubled.

paragraphs.en: The H-2A visa has no numerical cap, unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work, which is limited to 66,000 a year. Even so, employers complain they aren't given all the workers they need. The process is cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable. One survey found that bureaucratic delays led the average H-2A worker to arrive on the job 22 days late. The shortage is compounded by federal immigration raids, which remove some workers and drive others underground.
paragraphs.zh: H-2A签证没有数量上限，不像用于非农业工作的H-2B签证，后者每年限制在66000个。即便如此，雇主仍抱怨他们没有得到所需的全部工人。这一过程繁琐、昂贵且不可靠。一项调查发现，官僚主义的延误导致H-2A工人平均晚到岗22天。联邦移民突击检查加剧了短缺，这些检查驱逐了一些工人并迫使其他工人转入地下。

sentences.en: The H-2A visa has no numerical cap, unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work, which is limited to 66,000 a year.
Even so, employers complain they aren't given all the workers they need.
The process is cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable.
One survey found that bureaucratic delays led the average H-2A worker to arrive on the job 22 days late.
The shortage is compounded by federal immigration raids, which remove some workers and drive others underground.

paragraphs.en: In a 2012 survey, 71 percent of tree-fruit growers and almost 80 percent of raisin and berry growers said they were short of labor. Some western farmers have responded by moving operations to Mexico. From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported. Little more than a decade later, the share of imports was 25.8 percent.
paragraphs.zh: 在2012年的一项调查中，71%的果树种植者和近80%的葡萄干和浆果种植者表示他们劳动力短缺。一些西部农民的应对方式是将业务转移到墨西哥。从1998年到2000年，美国人消费的水果中有14.5%是进口的。仅仅十多年后，进口份额达到了25.8%。

sentences.en: In a 2012 survey, 71 percent of tree-fruit growers and almost 80 percent of raisin and berry growers said they were short of labor.
Some western farmers have responded by moving operations to Mexico.
From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported.
Little more than a decade later, the share of imports was 25.8 percent.

paragraphs.en: In effect, the U.S. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it.
paragraphs.zh: 实际上，美国可以进口食品，或者可以进口采摘食品的工人。

sentences.en: In effect, the U.S. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it.

insights.en: Even dairy farms, where robots do a small share of milking, have a long way to go before they're automated.
insights.note: 句子结构在四六级和考研阅读中具有较高代表性：主句中插入非限制性定语从句、末尾附加时间状语从句的组合模式常见；"havealongwaytogo"是常考的习惯表达；"before"引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时代替将来时的"主将从现"原则也是常考语法点。掌握本句结构后可迁移到大量类似句式。

insights.en: As a result, farms have grown increasingly reliant on temporary guest workers using the H-2A visa to fill the gaps in the workforce.
insights.note: 本句是典型的"主语+系动词+表语"结构，系动词grow表示状态变化，表语中包含形容词加介词短语以及分词定语和不定式状语，这种层层修饰的表语结构在四六级和考研阅读中非常常见。句首的结果状语"Asaresult"也是真题中高频的衔接表达。掌握本句的分析方法可以迁移到大量类似的"主系表+修饰成分"句型中。

insights.en: Starting around 2012, requests for the visas rose sharply; from 2011 to 2016 the number of visas issued more than doubled.
insights.note: 分号连接两个主句、句首放时间范围、名词后接分词作后置修饰，这些都属于常见书面说明文结构。掌握这种读法后，处理数据描述类句子很有迁移性。

insights.en: Even so, employers complain they aren't given all the workers they need.
insights.note: 本句的"主句+宾语从句+定语从句"结构是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式,宾语从句省略引导词、定语从句省略关系代词作宾语都是常考考点,且被动语态在宾语从句中的使用也很典型。学生掌握此句型后可大量迁移到其他真题句,典型性较高。

insights.en: In a 2012 survey, 71 percent of tree-fruit growers and almost 80 percent of raisin and berry growers said they were short of labor.
insights.note: 本句是典型的主语+said+宾语从句结构,在四六级和考研阅读中频繁出现,复合主语和省略that的宾语从句也是常考点,掌握后可大量复用到类似的调查报告、研究陈述类句子中。

vocab.cn: （一国或一地区的）劳动力，劳动人口
越来越;日益;不断增加地
消耗，耗费（燃料、能源、时间等）
